rna.text: Miri is a human Orzhov tithe taker on Ravnica, who subdues a citizen refusing the thirty-percent tithe and secretly gives her father the money she skimmed, since the family fortune was lost with the Ghost Council.

She also secretly works for a fleshmage and gives half her pay to help citizens short on tithes, and when she overhears a woman begging Jarek for her life with information on a Vitu-Ghazi vulnerability, she steals the dead spy's Selesnyan robes.
Going undercover among the Selesnyan initiates, she befriends Danika, Caz and Vasil, and Danika takes an elder's punishment for her after her growth spell fails.

At Vitu-Ghazi a mysterious artifact appears in her pocket and reveals that the world tree is fragile, and Miri's mother gives her the Crown of Convergence to give her father in place of the vulnerability.
